$comment: Shots for `npm run visuals`. Each shot is captured in Paper and Night (?theme=paper|night) at 2x. Summary visuals are staged from each product's full UI (the original product is the source of truth, never its demo): `viewport` sizes the window, `inject` is CSS added first (a string or a list) that hides chrome and resizes or zooms panels so the picture is full and composed, and `actions` run in order to load content: {"click": selector}, {"fill": selector, "text": ...}, {"press": key}, {"select": selector, "value": ...}, {"upload": selector, "file": path from the repo root}, {"hover": selector}, {"focus": selector} (then {"press": key} types into it), {"blur": true} (drops focus, so no focus ring shows), {"inject": css} (CSS added at that point, for chrome that has to stay usable until then), {"scrollTo": y}, {"waitFor": selector, "state"?: visible|hidden|attached, "timeout"?: ms}, {"wait": ms}. `selector` crops the capture to one element. `thumb: true` makes it the project's landing visual. `local: true` marks a shot of a frozen demo on a copyrighted test song: it is written to .local-visuals/<project>/ (gitignored, outside public/) and never used as a thumb, card image or index entry. Recordings dropped in visuals/raw/<project>/ are encoded automatically.
$posters: Seconds into a recording for its poster (default 1), where the first second is an intro card.
